instrument: NC Utilities Commission order denying Duke Energy gas turbine (week of Sept 21, 2026)
summary: The Commission denied Duke Energy's request to build a $584 million, 255 MW natural gas turbine, citing unanswered questions about electricity demand, project cost and cost allocation, including data center demand.

source.citation: Brad Nowak weekly roundup (LinkedIn, linked), Sept 26, 2026
